metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Stoneline Journeys (travel booking); Platform: Google Cloud europe-west1 (zones europe-west1-b/europe-west1-c/europe-west1-d); network range 10.190.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster stonel-prod-europe (GKE); reservations-api pods run with 8 GiB memory limits; deployments are canary releases with automated analysis; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
investigation_questions: Which service or component is the origin of the failure?
What is the identifier of the change that caused the incident?
Who (account or automation identity) executed the change that caused the incident?
Which change occurred shortly before the first OOM kill but is unrelated? Provide its identifier.
Which version of the service introduced the defect?
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which change restored normal service? Provide its change identifier.
